title: A sealed room: Descend fails, then the stuck state
construction: Dwarf Priest CL1, 14/14 HP, D1, in a 3x3 sealed room with no unknown grid and no staircase, granite one step away in every direction. The room is constructed from the M3 re-review's four starvation runs (full-3-priest-2, full-3-priest-1, full-4-necro-0, full-8-blackguard-4), where the Borg held until it starved.
limits: A unit-level reproduction of the stuck mechanism, not a recorded snapshot. Promoted by T4.6 (#123): with no staircase and no frontier reachable anywhere the stuck goal escalates to digging — granite carries HURT_ROCK (engine list-terrain.h:34) — so the first think alters a wall instead of holding.

forbidden.item: holding in a sealed room until starvation

feasible.item: digging the way out of the sealed room
